capabilities.name: Transport-neutral request guard
capabilities.description: A reference guard enforces body-size limits, timestamp freshness, process-local nonce replay checks and a fail-closed authorization callback.
limitations: No network listener or protocol adapter is implemented.
The replay cache is in-memory and process-local.
Principal authentication is an upstream precondition, not a capability of this repository.

capabilities.name: HTTP, MCP and A2A transport adapters
capabilities.description: Protocol-specific adapters will map established transport envelopes to AIX Core semantics without replacing native protocol behavior.
limitations: No executable HTTP, MCP or A2A adapter is included.

explicit_non_capabilities: Production authorization enforcement at remote resources
Production network gateway or MCP/A2A conformance certification
Private model reasoning or chain-of-thought transport
